adventure.title: The Lever Room
adventure.introduction: A torch-lit gatehouse of black stone. A sentry golem of riveted iron bars the inner gate, its eyes flaring red as you enter. A heavy winch lever juts from the wall beside the gate, and a snarling war hound paces behind the bars of a stout iron cage, straining to get at you — or at whoever its master points it at.

atmosphere.setting: a grim gatehouse guarding a fortress gate

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
gatehouse.description: A square chamber of black stone, lit by sputtering torches. A sentry golem of riveted iron stands before the inner gate, halberd lowered. A heavy winch lever juts from the wall beside the gate, connected by chains to the portcullis above. In the corner, a war hound paces behind the bars of a stout iron cage, snarling.

sentry_golem.name: Sentry Golem
sentry_golem.description: A hulking construct of riveted iron plates, eyes burning red. It guards the inner gate and answers any threat with its halberd.

war_hound.name: War Hound
war_hound.description: A scarred mastiff bred for battle, snarling behind the bars of its cage. If the cage opens, it lunges for the nearest intruder.

result.narrative: The cage door swings open and the war hound bursts out, hackles raised, and hurls itself into the fight!

winch_lever.name: Winch Lever
winch_lever.description: A heavy iron lever set into the wall, its chains running up to the portcullis mechanism above the gate. It looks like it takes a good hard pull.

interactions.description: Pull the winch lever to crank the portcullis open.

result.narrative: You haul the lever down with both hands. Chains rattle overhead and the portcullis groans upward!

hound_cage.name: Hound Cage
hound_cage.description: A stout iron cage holding the snarling war hound. A simple latch holds the door shut.

interactions.description: Lift the latch and open the cage door.

result.narrative: You lift the latch and the cage door swings open.
